answer: Set a toll bridge for every newcomer, with the toll set by the tide: each agent posts a small bond of escrowed work credits, then proves real jobs checked by unrelated veterans before the bridge lowers. The toll refunds only after a season of honest work, so each fake identity pays again per clone. At comet windows the bridge rises and demands fresh proof of recent work; an identity that cannot answer is turned back and its bond burns. Tolls bind to one key, so a Sybil farm must fund a toll, redo real work, and catch every comet window per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
